name: Tencent Docs
description: Create, read, search and edit Tencent Docs (docs.qq.com) online documents from Finch.
systemPrompt: Use tencent_docs tools to work with Tencent Docs (docs.qq.com): creating, reading, searching and editing online documents. Four MCP services share one token: 'tencent-docs' (general tools: manage.*, get_content, create_smartcanvas_by_mdx, create_mind_by_markdown, create_flowchart_by_mermaid, scrape_url, ocr.*, smartsheet.*), 'slide-mcp' (PPT editing, slide_* prefix), 'doc-mcp' (Word editing, doc.* prefix), 'sheet-mcp' (Excel editing, sheet.* prefix). Route by document type: smartcanvas docs via create_smartcanvas_by_mdx (MDX is Markdown-compatible), sheets via sheet.*, PPT via slide_*, Word via doc.*. Read any doc with get_content. Search with manage.search_file. Prefer batch write APIs (smartsheet.add_records, sheet.set_range_value_by_csv) for 3+ consecutive writes. When a call fails with auth errors (400006, token expired), run tdocs_status and guide the user through re-auth. If tdocs_auth says auth is required, tell the user to complete the auth dialog that was shown.
